# 3D scene tools

6 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `add_mesh`

Add a MeshInstance3D node with a primitive mesh (box, sphere, cylinder, plane, capsule, torus, quad, prism) to the current 3D scene

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new MeshInstance3D node (default: 'MeshInstance3D') |
| `mesh_type` | `string` | — | Primitive mesh type to create (default: 'box') One of: `"box"`, `"sphere"`, `"cylinder"`, `"plane"`, `"capsule"`, `"torus"`, `"quad"`, `"prism"`. |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Position in local space (default: origin) Array items are `number`. |
| `rotation` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Rotation in degrees (default: zero) Array items are `number`. |
| `scale` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Scale (default: 1,1,1) Array items are `number`. |
| `mesh_properties` | `object` | — | Properties of the primitive mesh resource itself, e.g. {"radius": 0.35, "height": 1.8} for a capsule or {"size": "Vector3(2, 0.2, 2)"} for a box. Without these the mesh keeps Godot's defaults. Unknown names come back in 'unknown_properties'. |
| `material` | `string` | — | res:// path to an existing Material to put on the mesh's surface (takes precedence over material_color) |
| `material_color` | `string` | — | Albedo colour for a StandardMaterial3D created for this mesh, e.g. '#c0392b' |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/10-scene-3d.json`, test 3D-01:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "TestBox",
  "mesh_type": "BoxMesh"
}
```

## `add_camera`

Add a Camera3D node to the current 3D scene with configurable projection, FOV or orthographic size, and clipping planes. Use take_screenshot with viewport 'camera' to see what it frames.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new Camera3D node (default: 'Camera3D') |
| `fov` | `number` | — | Field of view in degrees for perspective projection (default: 75). Ignored by an orthogonal camera. |
| `size` | `number` | — | Height of the view in world units for an orthogonal camera (default: 1) — the only parameter that frames it. Ignored by a perspective camera. |
| `projection` | `string` | — | Projection type (default: 'perspective') One of: `"perspective"`, `"orthogonal"`, `"frustum"`. |
| `near` | `number` | — | Near clipping plane distance (default: 0.05) |
| `far` | `number` | — | Far clipping plane distance (default: 4000) |
| `current` | `boolean` | — | Make this the active camera for the viewport (default: false) |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Position in local space Array items are `number`. |
| `rotation` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Rotation in degrees Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/10-scene-3d.json`, test 3D-02:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "TestCam",
  "position": "Vector3(0, 2, 5)"
}
```

## `add_light`

Add a 3D light node (DirectionalLight3D, OmniLight3D, or SpotLight3D) to the current scene

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new light node. Defaults to the light type class name. |
| `light_type` | `string` | — | Type of light to create (default: 'directional') One of: `"directional"`, `"omni"`, `"spot"`. |
| `color` | `string` | — | Light color as HTML hex string, e.g. '#ffffff' (default: white) |
| `energy` | `number` | — | Light energy/intensity multiplier (default: 1.0) |
| `cast_shadow` | `boolean` | — | Whether this light casts shadows (default: false) |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Position in local space Array items are `number`. |
| `rotation` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Rotation in degrees Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/10-scene-3d.json`, test 3D-03:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "TestLight",
  "light_type": "DirectionalLight3D"
}
```

## `set_environment`

Create or configure the WorldEnvironment node: background mode/color, ambient light, fog, and tonemapping. Finds an existing WorldEnvironment in the scene or creates a new one.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | — | Path to an existing WorldEnvironment node. Omit to auto-find or create one. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for a newly created WorldEnvironment node (default: 'WorldEnvironment') |
| `background_mode` | `string` | — | Background rendering mode One of: `"clear_color"`, `"color"`, `"sky"`, `"canvas"`, `"keep"`, `"camera_feed"`. |
| `background_color` | `string` | — | Background color as HTML hex string, e.g. '#87ceeb' (used when background_mode is 'color') |
| `background_energy` | `number` | — | Background energy multiplier |
| `ambient_light_color` | `string` | — | Ambient light color as HTML hex string |
| `ambient_light_energy` | `number` | — | Ambient light energy (0 = no ambient, 1 = full) |
| `fog_enabled` | `boolean` | — | Enable or disable volumetric fog |
| `fog_density` | `number` | — | Fog density (higher = thicker fog) |
| `tonemap_mode` | `string` | — | Tone mapping operator One of: `"linear"`, `"reinhard"`, `"filmic"`, `"aces"`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/10-scene-3d.json`, test 3D-04:

```json
{
  "ambient_light_color": "#333333",
  "ambient_light_energy": 1
}
```

## `add_gridmap`

Add a GridMap node to the current 3D scene, optionally loading a MeshLibrary resource

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `parent_path` | `string` | — | Path to the parent node. Omit or use '.' for scene root. |
| `node_name` | `string` | — | Name for the new GridMap node (default: 'GridMap') |
| `cell_size` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Size of each cell in world units (default: 1,1,1) Array items are `number`. |
| `mesh_library` | `string` | — | res:// path to a MeshLibrary resource to assign to the GridMap (optional) |
| `position` | `object`, `string`, `array` | — | Position in local space Array items are `number`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/10-scene-3d.json`, test 3D-06:

```json
{
  "parent_path": ".",
  "node_name": "TestGrid",
  "cell_size": "Vector3(1, 1, 1)"
}
```

## `get_3d_scene_info`

Scan the current scene and return all Node3D nodes with their type, transform, and type-specific properties (mesh, camera FOV, light color, etc.)

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | — | Root node path to start scanning from. Omit to scan the entire scene. |
| `depth` | `number` | — | Maximum recursion depth (default: 64) |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/10-scene-3d.json`, test 3D-05:

```json
{}
```
